findings.correctionCriterion: Scope the home’s historical-learning promise to accommodate orientation and histories of complementary practices, without asserting that every chapter describes a modern component replacing a historical approach.
findings.evidence: home.learning-approach-feature-element.0047 says, “Each chapter contrasts the modern component with the historical approach it replaced.” The same home now introduces both courses. source.043 is explicitly an orientation without a new component; source.044 explains that reporting conditions and measuring variation answer different questions, rather than presenting one as replacing the other. The frozen requirement appropriately includes coherence with the course introduction, but this categorical replacement claim exceeds the supplied lesson evidence.
findings.learnerConsequence: The home can give learners an inaccurate expectation that each practical chapter teaches a component replacement and its causal history. The lessons themselves explain their actual comparisons and limits, so this does not block their reproduction or interpretation.
